gates.citation: Fukuchi CA, Fukuchi RK, Duarte M (2018), PeerJ 6:e4640 (WBDS, figshare 5722711, CC-BY 4.0); 2-D sagittal Newton-Euler inverse dynamics validated against the dataset's own joint moments, 5 subjects x self-selected treadmill.

reference.citation: Fukuchi CA, Fukuchi RK, Duarte M (2018), PeerJ 6:e4640 (WBDS, figshare 5722711, CC-BY 4.0); 2-D sagittal Newton-Euler inverse dynamics validated against the dataset's own joint moments, 5 subjects x self-selected treadmill.
reference.description: inverseDynamics2D on real WBDS markers + GRF, per-joint agreement of the recovered sagittal moment with the dataset's own moment over 5 subjects, reproduces the distal-to-proximal accuracy gradient: ankle r=0.973 (ref push-off peak 1.659 N*m/kg), knee r=0.847, hip r=0.774 (hip peak inflates to 1.46 vs 0.93)
